_doc: Reference briefs — Step 0 of the art pipeline (see docs/art/REFERENCE_RESEARCH_STEP.md). Built from web reference research, NOT off the top of the head. gen_from_brief.py builds every prompt from these; never hand-write a prompt that bypasses this file. Keys match the game's unit art keys (assets/sprites/units/...). A '<key>__dead' target composes the base unit's subject+family with corpse_by_family.
style: pixel art, high contrast, bold clean readable silhouette, full color, single character
framing_live: full body, centered, standing, plain solid flat gray background, no ground, no shadow
framing_dead: top-down three-quarter view looking down at the body lying flat on the ground, centered, plain solid flat gray background
base_negatives: blurry, jpeg artifacts, text, watermark, signature, multiple characters, cropped, border, purple tint, monochrome, extra limbs, deformed
live_negatives: cast shadow, drop shadow, ground shadow, shadow under feet, floor, ground, base, platform, standing surface, reflection, background scenery, wall, room
_death_canon: DEAD and DOWNED both lie ON THEIR SIDE, crumpled where they fell — a pose the unit would never hold while alive. Limbs out / bent at odd but REALISTIC angles (not tidy, not symmetric, not laid-out-in-a-grave). Mouth open. Pool of blood (dead) under the body. NOT standing, NOT on-the-back-arms-crossed, NOT top-down neat. Tech/robots: no blood — broken apart, pieces missing, wires/cables hanging out, sparks, dead optic.

key_features: dead mutant collapsed on its side on the ground
crumpled where it fell, limbs bent at odd realistic angles
mouth open, dead unglowing eyes, head lolled back
a pool of green ichor spreading out from under the body
mutant.negatives: standing, upright, on its back, arms crossed, tidy symmetric pose, top-down, laid out in a coffin, alive, glowing eyes, action pose, floating

key_features: destroyed robot broken apart on the ground on its side
pieces snapped off, torn wires and cables hanging out
dark dead optic, sparks and scorch marks, leaking oil
robot.negatives: hovering, flying, upright, intact, alive, glowing eye, standing, floating, action pose

key_features: dead human collapsed on its side on the ground
crumpled where it fell, one arm flung out, legs bent awkwardly
mouth open, head lolled, limp and lifeless
a dark red blood pool spreading out from under the body
human.negatives: standing, upright, on its back, arms crossed, tidy symmetric pose, top-down, laid out in a coffin, alive, aiming, action pose, floating

key_features: wounded mutant knocked down on its side, still alive but incapacitated
collapsed on the ground clutching a wound, one limb propping up weakly
grimacing, struggling, small smear of green ichor
clearly hurt and prone, NOT a tidy corpse and NOT standing
mutant.negatives: standing, upright, walking, dead, big blood pool, action pose, on its back, top-down, floating

key_features: disabled robot fallen on the ground on its side, sparking
one rotor bent, a couple of loose wires, flickering optic
damaged and grounded but mostly intact, NOT blown apart
robot.negatives: hovering, flying, upright, fully destroyed, blown apart, intact and flying, standing, floating

key_features: wounded soldier knocked down on their side, still alive but incapacitated
collapsed on the ground clutching a wound, propped on one arm weakly
grimacing in pain, small blood smear, dropped weapon nearby
clearly hurt and prone, NOT a tidy corpse and NOT standing
human.negatives: standing, upright, walking, dead, big blood pool, aiming, action pose, on its back, top-down, floating
